message.content:
This is a set put up for retail sale under GRI 3(b), so the classification follows the component that gives the kit its essential character. That component is the acrylic paints.

The paints fall under 3213.10 (artists' colors in sets). Heading 3213 covers "Artists', students' or signboard painters' colors, modifying tints, amusement colors and the like, in tablets, tubes, jars, bottles, pans or similar forms or packings." Subheading 3213.10.00 covers "Colors in sets," and the 10-digit statistical code is 3213.10.0000.

CBP rulings on similar paint-your-own kits have classified them under 3213.10.00, with the paint providing the essential character. Some kits with a figurine or a different main item have been classified differently, but here the clear acrylic sheet is the canvas and the paint is the key component.
